notes.title: 3/23 update-2
notes.content:
1: Players can see your record in Deep Dream Mode Now!

2: Players can reset all data now.

3: Fix some localization problem

notes.title: 3.23 update
notes.content:
1: Added a new game mode "Deep Dream" that allows you to play as many days as possible. You can select game mode between regular mode and Deep Dream by starting a new game.

2: Fix some UI problem

3: Reduce Soberness damage of "Licking Teeth" form 50 to 35.

notes.title: 3/22 update-2
notes.content:
1: Fixed that played who have played Demo version can not unlock second character (but all save datas has to be reset, I'm terribly sorry about this!)

2: Sleep Pill' soberness damage reduced from 25 to 20.

3: Can go back to main menu from character selection.
